result.title: CoMET: Tracking the Shared Pose Error of Roadside Messages for Asynchronous Vehicle-Infrastructure Cooperative 3D Detection
result.comment: 25 pages, 4 figures. Code and experimental results archived at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23999418
result.summary: A roadside sensor can detect vehicles hidden from the ego vehicle, but a pose error shifts every detection in the same message. We study asynchronous vehicle-infrastructure cooperative 3D detection on V2X-Seq using only information available at decision time, without ground truth, future frames, or per-pair calibration offsets at inference. Objects seen by both sensors reveal the shared translation, but even at zero added delay, 38% of validation messages have no matched pair. We propose CoMET (Common-Mode Error Tracking), which estimates this translation over time. At each message arrival, CoMET matches vehicle and roadside detections, estimates the offset from mutually nearest pairs, and updates a Kalman filter for that sender. When no pair matches, the filter carries its estimate forward. The correction applies to all roadside boxes, including those unseen by the ego vehicle. The estimator has no learned parameters; a separate frozen head ranks the merged detections. Across four delays from 0 to 400 ms on 21 validation sequences, CoMET averages 66.63 bird's-eye-view AP at IoU 0.7, compared with 63.18 for the same late fusion using uncorrected online poses and 62.96 for the best intermediate-fusion baseline. Across five detectors from three architectures, CoMET gains 2.2 to 3.5 AP points over online poses and 0.3 to 0.6 over estimating the offset from the current message alone. We find that the benchmark uses a zero offset as a placeholder in 28% of validation messages and that its offset search reaches the boundary in 45% of the rest. These offsets affect the labels for objects seen only from the roadside. Under two alternative label references, CoMET improves on uncorrected online poses in every evaluated population. Retraining intermediate fusion with CoMET poses and corrected labels improves detection on all three architectures tested, with statistically significant gains on two.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究异步车路协同3D检测中路边消息的整体位姿平移误差，提出无学习参数的 CoMET：在各消息到达时匹配路侧与自车检测、用互为最近的点对估计偏移，并以 Kalman 滤波按发送方持续跟踪，无匹配时沿用先前估计来校正全部路边框；同时报告基准中零偏移占位与偏移搜索触边的标签问题。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「用互见证据估计并随时间维护一个共享隐变量、证据缺失时携带状态前行」的机制，可供核查是否能类比 LVR 中潜在状态的维护、视觉证据筛选与缺失证据处理；关于基准占位偏移影响纯路侧目标标签的分析，也可能启发对证据与评价可靠性的检查，但领域相距较远，迁移价值需较多核查。
